name: JellySubSync
description: Shift subtitles earlier or later from the TV remote (JellyTvOverlay app).
overview: Pause twice quickly in Jellyfin on Android TV and the JellyTvOverlay app (with the JellyTvOverlay plugin) shows a subtitle sync box. The older JellyXR TV app still works this release. JellySubSync writes a shifted copy of the subtitle track (the original stays untouched), remembers the offset per item, and the app restarts playback on the synced track.
changelog: 1.1.0.0: The sync box now works with the JellyTvOverlay app (JellyXR TV is still supported this release). 1.0.2.0: Fix HTTP 500 on Jellyfin 10.11 and 12.x (user and version APIs changed); jellysubsync.log is written from startup and logs every error. 1.0.1.0: Plugin logo. 1.0.0.0: First release. Shifts text subtitles (SRT, ASS/SSA, WebVTT, and embedded text tracks) for the JellyXR TV app sync box (app 1.2.0 or newer). Opt-in: turn it on for all titles, or only for chosen libraries, shows and movies.
